{{Quote|Hey, buddy, are you hungry?''"<br />"''Yeah.|Ahsoka Tano and Spots Podal|<ref name="TCaJ" />}}
'''Spots Podal''' was a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Podal encountered the fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was fleeing the combined forces of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. The Gotal gave Tano his [[Clothing/Legends|cloak]] so that she could conceal herself in exchange for a [[Ration bar/Legends|ration bar]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What do you want?''"<br />"''Your cloak.|Podal and Tano|<ref name="TCaJ" />}}
[[File:SpotsPodal2-TCAJ.png|thumb|left|220px|Podal sitting in the underworld streets]]
Spots Podal, a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], lived on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Podal stayed on the streets of [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant's underworld]].<ref name="TCaJ" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="DM:DS">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> Podal was drinking a bottle of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] on one of the streets when he encountered the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Tano was fleeing the forces of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] after being framed for the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]]&mdash;who [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombed]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]]&mdash;and for involvement in the Temple hangar's bombing. Tano gave Podal a [[Ration bar/Legends|ration bar]], and in exchange he gave her his [[Clothing/Legends|cloak]], which she wanted in order to conceal herself. After the deal was made, Tano left Podal to eat his bar and enjoy his drink.<ref name="TCaJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Podal had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wore a green cloak that had holes in its hood for his cranial horns. He spoke and comprehended [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], although he bleated his words during conversation. The Gotal was initially reluctant when Tano offered him a ration bar but ultimately gave her his cloak when she explained that she needed it.<ref name="TCaJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Podal_concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Spots Podal concept art]]
Spots Podal first appeared in the episode "[[To Catch a Jedi]]" of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', in the program's [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]]. The episode aired on [[February 23]], [[2013]]. Although he was not identified in the actual episode, Podal's name was revealed in the episode's [http://starwars.com/explore/the-clone-wars/ep519/#!/about accompanying guide] on [[StarWars.com]]. He was voiced by Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]].<ref name="TCaJ Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/to-catch-a-jedi-episode-guide|text="To Catch a Jedi" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> Filoni&mdash;who had previously voiced the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] [[Embo/Legends|Embo]] and [[Jakoli/Legends|Jakoli]] in the episodes "[[Bounty Hunters (episode)|Bounty Hunters]]" and "[[The Box]]"&mdash;has noted that he is reluctant to provide voicework for various characters in the series.<ref name="Filoni">{{SW|url=video/bounty-hunters-episode-featurette|text="Bounty Hunters" Episode Featurette}}</ref>
